evidenceBoundary.exact: Current complete selected caller prefix, same cached/base Data getter, all generated setter normal programs, buffered byte/DWORD/Single sources and distinct unmanaged cursor source authenticated against current native bytes and metadata.
evidenceBoundary.direct: Actual source return bits go to their metadata-owned Data fields, with final wrapper reload and correctly restored setter frames. Shared physical reference helper returns its initialized local output after selected slot-five dispatch; all reference post-store edges reach the same disabled helper.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: Coherent compatible nonaliasing Reader/wrapper/base/cache state, initialized normal getter guards, ordinary Win64 nonvolatile preservation, selected typed normal generic/provider/slot-five returns and stable disabled barrier flag. No live branch or provider choice is observed.
evidenceBoundary.structuralOnly: Anonymous runtime cache/MethodInfo and formatter-state representation outside the named current field and context proofs.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: Physical named ReadValue identity, actual inflated MethodInfo/formatter selection, enabled barrier effects, constructor/header/failure/refill and allocation/global effects, complete recursive SubSpeed/MoveTo records, actions, Buff roots and gameplay execution.
